cands.name: Lauren Book
cands.bio: Democratic nominee. Former Florida Senate minority leader (2021-2024; senator 2016-2024). Founder of the child-safety nonprofit Lauren's Kids; University of Miami education graduate and former teacher.
cands.local_ties: Born in Hollywood, Florida; represented Broward County in the Senate.

record.text: Florida Senate 2016-2024; minority leader April 2021 to Nov 2024. Founded Lauren's Kids in 2007.

controversies.text: Arrested for trespassing with Nikki Fried and nine others at an April 2023 protest against a proposed six-week abortion ban (Wikipedia).

endorsements.text: Rep. Jared Moskowitz, Sens. Lori Berman, Mack Bernard and Tina Polsky, former Sen. Kevin Rader.
The Palm Beach Post editorial board (Oct 13, 2026).

cands.gaps: Not a sitting senator (served 2016-2024). No donor reporting collected for this race (her committees were not researched). Owner-source search not run (web search quota exhausted).

Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).

Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).
